broker:
토스증권 Open API (Toss Securities). Verified independently on 2026-09-25. I re-fetched every primary source with curl and a browser User-Agent into /tmp/tmp.h7QxqFuKbi: llms.txt, overview.md, faq.md, openapi.json, api-reference/README.md and asyncapi.json. All returned HTTP 200.

Facts about the spec itself:
- openapi.json declares "openapi": "3.1.0", even though llms.txt calls it OpenAPI 3.0. It uses 3.1-style nullable types such as ["string","null"].
- info.version is "1.2.17"; the server is https://openapi.tossinvest.com.
- It has exactly 36 REST operations, and README.md lists the same 36.
- asyncapi.json is AsyncAPI 3.0.0, v1.2.2.

The endpoints below cover the 5 core read endpoints, plus orders and candles as optional helpers for rebuilding past values.

Secondary code, unofficial and used for context only: github.com/JungHoonGhae/tossinvest-cli (Go), HEAD commit 975c7c6, re-cloned with --depth 1. I confirmed the paths it is cited for.
auth:
Token request: POST https://openapi.tossinvest.com/oauth2/token with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
- Body fields (all required): grant_type=client_credentials (the enum's only value), client_id, client_secret.
- The operation has "security": [], and the Auth tag says it is the only endpoint called without an Authorization header.

Success is 200 in standard OAuth2 shape, not the {"result": ...} envelope: {"access_token":"<JWT>","token_type":"Bearer","expires_in":86400}.
- expires_in is int64, described as 토큰 만료까지 남은 초 (seconds until expiry).
- 86400 (24h) is only the example value.

Refresh: there is no refresh token. The spec says to re-issue from the same endpoint on expiry, and that only one access token is valid per client: re-issuing immediately invalidates the previous one. Calls with the old token get 401 token-revoked. The FAQ says to share one token across all processes, because separate processes that each issue a token revoke each other. In practice:
- Cache {access_token, issued_at + expires_in} on disk and share it across processes/cron jobs.
- Re-issue only on expiry, 401 expired-token or 401 token-revoked. Guard re-issue with a file lock.

Token-endpoint errors (OAuth2 format; identify by the "error" string, not "code"):
- 400 invalid_request, e.g. "Required parameter is missing."
- 400 unsupported_grant_type, "Only client_credentials grant type is supported."
- 401 invalid_client (wrong id/secret or client disabled), with header WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="openapi". Per the FAQ, error_description says which check failed, e.g. "Client authentication failed: client_secret".
- 403 access_denied, "IP address not allowed".
- The error enum also lists invalid_grant and unauthorized_client.
- error_description may be omitted when it contains non-ASCII characters.
- CORRECTION: 429 on /oauth2/token uses the shared RateLimitExceeded response, which is the common ErrorResponse envelope {"error":{"requestId","code":"rate-limit-exceeded","message"}}. So on this endpoint "error" can be a string (OAuth2) or an object (429). Branch on HTTP status first.

Setup before calls work (overview.md 시작하기):
1. Log into Toss WTS, go to 설정 > Open API and issue client_id / client_secret.
2. Register allowed IPs under 허용 IP 관리. Unlisted IPs are rejected with 403 on REST and on the WebSocket handshake.
3. POST /oauth2/token.
4. Send Authorization: Bearer {access_token} on every call, plus X-Tossinvest-Account on account, asset, order and conditional-order calls.

The official docs describe no Toss-app approval, push confirmation, fingerprint or certificate step, either per call or per token. Once the credentials and IP allowlist are set up, token re-issue is unattended.

401 codes on the regular API (common ErrorResponse):
- invalid-token, expired-token, token-revoked, login-user-not-found
- edge-blocked when the Authorization header is missing
- The spec's Unauthorized response also sends WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="openapi", error="invalid_token", error_description="Token has expired" (example).
account_selection:
Header X-Tossinvest-Account: {accountSeq}. The spec parameter AccountSeq is in: header, required, schema integer/int64, with example 1. Its description: "API 요청 시 사용할 계좌의 accountSeq. GET /api/v1/accounts 응답의 accountSeq 값을 사용합니다." Use accountSeq, not accountNo; the overview curl example is "X-Tossinvest-Account: 1".

Operations that declare the header (verified by scanning parameters):
- GET/POST /api/v1/orders, and GET /api/v1/orders/{orderId} with its modify and cancel
- all /api/v1/conditional-orders operations
- GET /api/v1/holdings, /api/v1/buying-power, /api/v1/sellable-quantity and /api/v1/commissions

It is not used on GET /api/v1/accounts (no parameters), /oauth2/token, market data, stock info, or exchange-rate (token only).

Errors:
- Header missing: 400 account-header-required ("x-tossinvest-account 헤더가 필요합니다.").
- Account not found: 404 account-not-found. This is explicit in the overview error table and in the buying-power spec. The holdings 404 references the generic NotFound response, whose example is stock-not-found.

There is no separate product code (unlike KIS's CANO + ACNT_PRDT_CD). To cover all of the user's accounts, loop over GET /api/v1/accounts result[] and call holdings and buying-power per accountSeq. The Account tag says only normal-status accounts are returned (해지·휴면 excluded), and the endpoint currently returns only BROKERAGE accounts.

endpoints.purpose: Issue an OAuth2 access token (client credentials)
endpoints.request:
Form fields:
- grant_type: required, enum ["client_credentials"]
- client_id: required string, e.g. "c_01HXYZABCDEFG123456789"
- client_secret: required string, format password

Overview curl: -d 'grant_type=client_credentials' -d 'client_id=xxx' -d 'client_secret=yyy'
endpoints.response_fields:
200 (bare OAuth2 JSON, no envelope):
- access_token: string, JWT; send as Authorization: Bearer
- token_type: enum ["Bearer"]
- expires_in: int64, seconds until expiry; example 86400

400/401/403 return OAuth2ErrorResponse:
- error: required, enum invalid_request|invalid_client|invalid_grant|unauthorized_client|unsupported_grant_type|access_denied
- error_description: optional
- error_uri: optional, uri

429 returns the common ErrorResponse {"error":{requestId,code,message}}. Rate Limits Group AUTH (5/s).
endpoints.source: https://openapi.tossinvest.com/openapi-docs/latest/openapi.json paths./oauth2/token.post; components.schemas.OAuth2TokenRequest/OAuth2TokenResponse/OAuth2ErrorResponse; components.responses.RateLimitExceeded; overview.md 시작하기; faq.md 인증·접속

endpoints.purpose: List the user's accounts to get accountSeq
endpoints.request: No query, path or account-header parameters.
endpoints.response_fields:
result: array of Account.
- accountNo: string, required; the account number, e.g. "12345678901"
- accountSeq: int64, required; the value for the X-Tossinvest-Account header
- accountType: required, enum BROKERAGE|OVERSEAS_DERIVATIVES|PENSION_SAVINGS|RESHORING_INVESTMENT; clients must accept unknown values

Behaviour:
- Only BROKERAGE (종합매매) accounts are returned today.
- Child (자녀) accounts are unusable.
- 해지·휴면 accounts are excluded.
- No accounts gives "result": [].

Errors: 401, 429, 500 (internal-error). Rate Limits Group ACCOUNT (1/s).

endpoints.purpose: Holdings plus summed valuation, cost basis and P/L for KR and US stocks (cash not included)
endpoints.request:
Query param symbol (optional; pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+$; KR 6-char code such as 005930 or 0101N0, or US ticker):
- If given, only that symbol is returned and the summary fields are recalculated for it. An unheld symbol returns 200 with zero summaries and items [] (example filteredBySymbolNotFound).
- If omitted, all holdings are returned.

Only KR and US stocks are included; overseas options and bonds are excluded.
endpoints.response_fields:
result (HoldingsOverview). All required: totalPurchaseAmount, marketValue, profitLoss, dailyProfitLoss, items.

Summary fields:
- totalPurchaseAmount: Price. 투자원금, summed per currency.
- marketValue: {amount: Price (시장 평가금액), amountAfterCost: Price (세금/수수료 공제 후 평가금액)}
- profitLoss: {amount: Price, amountAfterCost: Price, rate, rateAfterCost}
- dailyProfitLoss: {amount: Price, rate}
- items: HoldingsItem[], empty when nothing is held.

Price object (description: per-currency sums with no FX conversion between currencies):
- krw: required, decimal string, maxLength 30. Sum of KRW-traded domestic holdings; "0" if none.
- usd: string|null. Sum of USD-traded holdings; null if none.

The summary rate, rateAfterCost and dailyProfitLoss.rate are decimal-ratio strings (0.1179 = 11.79%), computed on the whole portfolio converted to KRW at the current FX rate.

HoldingsItem (all required; values in the item's own currency):
- symbol, name
- marketCountry: KR|US
- currency: KRW|USD
- quantity (decimal string), lastPrice, averagePurchasePrice
- marketValue: {purchaseAmount, amount, amountAfterCost}
- profitLoss: {amount, amountAfterCost, rate, rateAfterCost}
- dailyProfitLoss: {amount, rate}
- cost: {commission (required), tax (string|null; null if none)}

Errors:
- 400 account-header-required
- 401
- 404: spec refs the generic NotFound, example stock-not-found; the overview maps a bad account to account-not-found
- 429
- 500 internal-error

Rate Limits Group ASSET (5/s).
endpoints.source: openapi.json paths./api/v1/holdings.get (examples withHoldings, filteredBySymbol, filteredByUsSymbol, filteredBySymbolNotFound, emptyHoldings); components.schemas.HoldingsOverview/Price/OverviewMarketValue/OverviewProfitLoss/OverviewDailyProfitLoss/HoldingsItem/MarketValue/ProfitLoss/DailyProfitLoss/Cost; tags[Asset]

endpoints.purpose: Cash buying power per currency (the only cash figure in the official API)
endpoints.request: Query currency: required, schema Currency enum KRW|USD. One currency per call, so KRW and USD take two calls.
endpoints.response_fields:
result (BuyingPowerResponse; both fields required):
- currency: KRW|USD
- cashBuyingPower: decimal string, maxLength 30. Described as "현금 기반 매수 가능 금액 (미수 미발생 기준). 순수 현금으로 매수할 수 있는 금액." KRW is a whole number of won; USD has decimals (dollars).

The endpoint description says it returns cash-based buying power excluding 미수거래.

Errors:
- 400 invalid-request, data {field:"currency", allowedValues:["KRW","USD"]}
- 400 account-header-required
- 401
- 404 account-not-found
- 429
- 500 internal-error

Rate Limits Group ORDER_INFO (6/s; 3/s from 09:00 to 09:10 KST).
endpoints.source: openapi.json paths./api/v1/buying-power.get (examples krw, usd), components.schemas.BuyingPowerResponse, tags[Order Info]

endpoints.purpose: KRW/USD exchange rate, current or at a past time, for converting USD holdings and cash
endpoints.request:
Query params:
- baseCurrency: required, Currency KRW|USD
- quoteCurrency: required, Currency KRW|USD; the same value as baseCurrency gives 400
- dateTime: optional, format date-time, example 2026-03-25T09:30:00+09:00; returns the rate valid at that time. Omit for the current rate.

On URL encoding: the spec gives the explicit '+' → %2B note only for candles' before param. For dateTime it is ordinary query encoding; requests' params= does it automatically.

The rate refreshes every minute and is for display/reference only; the rate actually applied to orders can differ.
endpoints.response_fields:
result (ExchangeRateResponse; all required):
- baseCurrency, quoteCurrency
- rate: decimal string. 매수 환율: 1 baseCurrency = rate quoteCurrency.
- midRate: decimal string. 매매기준율, interbank mid.
- basisPoint: decimal string, (rate - midRate) / midRate * 10000; can be negative, e.g. "-19.6".
- rateChangeType: UP|EQUAL|DOWN
- validFrom, validUntil: date-time; the validity window, usually 1 minute.

Errors:
- 400 invalid-request, data.field "baseCurrency" + allowedValues for an unsupported currency, or data.field "baseCurrency,quoteCurrency" when both are the same
- 404 exchange-rate-not-found ("요청한 시점의 환율 정보가 없습니다.")
- 429
- 500

Rate Limits Group MARKET_INFO (3/s).

endpoints.purpose: (Optional) Order and fill history: trade cash flows inside the account, with commission and tax. It does NOT show deposits, withdrawals or dividends.
endpoints.request:
Query params:
- status: required, OPEN|CLOSED. OPEN covers PENDING, PARTIAL_FILLED, PENDING_CANCEL and PENDING_REPLACE. CLOSED covers FILLED, CANCELED, REJECTED, REPLACED, CANCEL_REJECTED, REPLACE_REJECTED and PARTIAL_FILLED.
- symbol: optional
- from / to: optional, format date, inclusive, KST, matched on orderedAt. If omitted, the whole period since account opening (FAQ).
- cursor: optional, CLOSED only
- limit: CLOSED only, 1-100, default 20

Only orders placed with Open-API-supported order types are returned (지정가, 시장가, 장마감지정가). 장전/장후 시간외종가 orders are not. Per the FAQ, app and WTS orders are included regardless of channel, as are fractional (소수점) and reserved orders.
endpoints.response_fields:
result (PaginatedOrderResponse; required orders, nextCursor, hasNext):
- orders[] (Order): orderId, symbol, side, orderType, timeInForce, status, price, quantity, orderAmount, currency, orderedAt, canceledAt, execution
  - side: BUY|SELL
  - orderType: LIMIT|MARKET
  - timeInForce: DAY|CLS|OPG
  - status: the OrderStatus enum
  - price: string|null; null for MARKET orders
  - orderAmount: USD, string|null; only for amount-based US market buys
  - orderedAt: ISO 8601 KST
  - canceledAt: string|null
- orders[].execution (OrderExecution; all keys required, nullable): filledQuantity, averageFilledPrice, filledAmount, commission, tax, filledAt, settlementDate (YYYY-MM-DD KST 결제 예정일). All amounts are native-currency decimal strings.
- nextCursor: string|null
- hasNext: boolean

One row per order; partial fills are aggregated into the average price and total quantity, and filledAt is the last fill. Rate Limits Group ORDER_HISTORY (5/s).
endpoints.sample_response_excerpt:
{"result":{"orders":[{"orderId":"0d5QIHjmtksbsmM-hBRAgP-ExI8iodGm9fAR5txelPfnMM8XQ_swoJdwL5RpGWMo","symbol":"005930","side":"BUY","orderType":"LIMIT","timeInForce":"DAY","status":"FILLED","price":"70000","quantity":"10","orderAmount":null,"currency":"KRW","orderedAt":"2026-03-28T09:30:00+09:00","canceledAt":null,"execution":{"filledQuantity":"10","averageFilledPrice":"70000","filledAmount":"700000","commission":"1400","tax":"0","filledAt":"2026-03-28T09:31:15+09:00","settlementDate":"2026-03-30"}}],"nextCursor":"eyJvcmRlcmVkQXQiOiIyMDI2LTAzLTI4VDA5OjMwOjAwKzA5OjAwIiwib3JkZXJJZCI6Ik9SRDIwMjYwMzI4MDAxIn0=","hasNext":true}}

This is example 'completedWithNextPage' (the CLOSED case). The earlier contract quoted the OPEN example 'pendingMixed' under a status=CLOSED URL.
endpoints.pagination: CLOSED: cursor-based. Pass result.nextCursor as cursor while hasNext is true; limit max 100. OPEN: returns everything, limit and cursor are ignored, only from/to apply, and nextCursor is always null / hasNext false.

endpoints.purpose: (Optional) Daily closing prices, for back-filling past valuations when no snapshot exists
endpoints.request:
Query params:
- symbol: required, pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+$
- interval: required, 1m|1d
- count: 1-200, default 100
- before: optional date-time, inclusive upper bound; pass the previous response's nextBefore unchanged. The spec says to encode '+' as %2B, e.g. before=2026-03-25T09:00:00%2B09:00.
- adjusted: optional boolean, default true (수정주가)

Data is available from 2022-11-23 for KR and from 2021-11-30 for US (FAQ).
endpoints.response_fields:
result (CandlePageResponse):
- candles[] (Candle; newest first): timestamp, openPrice, highPrice, lowPrice, closePrice, volume (all decimal strings), currency
  - timestamp for 1d: the trading day, time fixed at local midnight (현지 자정 고정)
  - timestamp for 1m: bar END time
- nextBefore: string|null; null on the last page

US 1d closePrice is the official regular-session close; volume may include extended hours (FAQ). Rate Limits Group MARKET_DATA_CHART (20/s).
endpoints.pagination: before / nextBefore, up to 200 candles per page. In the spec example nextBefore equals the oldest returned candle's timestamp and before is inclusive, so de-duplicate by timestamp across pages.
endpoints.source: openapi.json paths./api/v1/candles.get (examples dailyCandles, minuteCandles, lastPage), components.schemas.CandlePageResponse/Candle; faq.md 시세·캔들

rate_limits:
Limits apply per client and per API group, in requests per second, and may change without notice (overview.md Rate Limits). Each operation's description ends with "**Rate Limits Group**: `X`"; I verified these for every endpoint used here.
- AUTH (token): 5/s
- ACCOUNT (accounts): 1/s
- ASSET (holdings): 5/s
- ORDER_INFO (buying-power): 6/s; 3/s from 09:00 to 09:10 KST
- MARKET_INFO (exchange-rate): 3/s
- ORDER_HISTORY (orders list): 5/s
- MARKET_DATA_CHART (candles): 20/s
- Also current, but not used here: MARKET_DATA 15/s, ORDER 10/s (10/s at peak), STOCK 5/s, STOCK_ALL 1/s.

Headers, on both success and 429 responses (overview; the FAQ says success responses always include them and they refresh every second per client):
- X-RateLimit-Limit: burst capacity per second
- X-RateLimit-Remaining: tokens left; 0 on a 429
- X-RateLimit-Reset: expected seconds until one token refills
- Retry-After: 429 only

429 codes: rate-limit-exceeded or edge-rate-limit-exceeded, in the common ErrorResponse envelope (this includes /oauth2/token).

Recommended handling: wait Retry-After, then exponential backoff (1s → 2s → 4s) with jitter, and slow down as X-RateLimit-Remaining drops.

WebSocket is not needed here. Its limits: 2 concurrent connections per account (계정당), 100 subscriptions per connection, 5 declarations/s.

Secondary, unofficial: tossinvest-cli docs/migration/open-api.md, measured 2026-06-30. Holdings got 429s far more often than 5/s explains, with the cause unconfirmed. Call holdings once per account per run, spaced at least 1s apart.
caveats: NO deposit/withdrawal (입출금), dividend (배당), interest (이자), 예수금 or cash-ledger/transaction-history endpoint exists in the official API. I re-verified this across all 36 REST operations in openapi.json v1.2.17 (the README lists the same 36) and in asyncapi.json. The terms 배당/입금/출금/dividend/withdraw/예수금/ledger/거래내역 do not name any endpoint or field. The only hits are false positives: 매입금액, DEPOSITARY_RECEIPT (an instrument type) and a 배당락 mention in the FAQ. /api/v1/stocks has no dividend field. External cash flows and dividends therefore need manual input or a CSV import of the 거래내역 export from the Toss app/WTS.

Secondary, unofficial, verified present in JungHoonGhae/tossinvest-cli @975c7c6: private WTS session endpoints on https://wts-cert-api.tossinvest.com:
- /api/v1/dividends/accounts/annual/history (and /by-payment-date), in internal/client/dividends.go
- POST /api/v1/profit/overview
- /api/v1/asset-snapshot/{all-accounts/}chart|page|detail-by-date

Plus https://wts-api.tossinvest.com/api/v3/my-assets/transactions/markets/{kr,us} (a ledger), in internal/ops/wts_operations.go.

These need a browser session: QR/link login with phone approval, and a server-side activity timer of about 7 days extended by one phone push via `auth extend` (docs/architecture.md). They are not OAuth, are undocumented, can change without notice, and carry terms-of-service risk. The repo's own migration doc says the official API has no ledger. Treat them as an opt-in fallback only.

Response envelope: success is {"result": <payload>} (ApiResponse). Errors are {"error": {requestId, code, message, data?}} (ErrorResponse/ApiError), and the two never appear together.

Exceptions on /oauth2/token: 200/400/401/403 are bare OAuth2 JSON, while its 429 uses the common error envelope.

Other details:
- error.message may be an empty string, so map on code.
- data keys vary by code: field, allowedValues, constraint, retryAfterSeconds and so on.
- Clients must tolerate unknown codes and enum values.

CORRECTION: requestId equals the X-Request-Id response header. But the overview says requestId can be missing on some responses; in that case use the referenceId or x-amz-cf-id response header. 'Every response carries X-Request-Id' is not guaranteed.

Multi-currency amounts: every money, quantity and rate value is a decimal STRING (format decimal, maxLength 30). Parse with decimal.Decimal, never float.
- Holdings summaries use Price {"krw": required string, "usd": string|null}. krw sums only KRW-traded holdings ("0" if none) and usd sums only USD-traded ones (null if none), with no FX conversion between them.
- Per-item amounts are in items[].currency.
- Only the summary rate fields (profitLoss.rate/rateAfterCost, dailyProfitLoss.rate) are computed on a KRW-converted total.
- Buying power is one currency per call.

No 'total assets' (총자산) endpoint exists. Build it per accountSeq: total_KRW = holdings.marketValue.amount.krw + (holdings.marketValue.amount.usd or 0) × FX + buying-power(KRW).cashBuyingPower + buying-power(USD).cashBuyingPower × FX.

For FX, midRate (매매기준율) is the more neutral valuation rate; rate is Toss's buy rate including spread. That choice is a design decision, not something the docs state.

cashBuyingPower is buying power (cash only, no 미수), not the deposit balance (예수금). How it treats pending-order reservations, unsettled sale proceeds and cross-currency 통합증거금 is undocumented, so cash totals are approximate.

Everything is point-in-time. The official API has no historical account value or position snapshots, so yearly growth requires the app to store its own periodic (e.g. daily) snapshots from day one.

For earlier periods, an approximate rebuild is possible from:
- GET /api/v1/orders?status=CLOSED (since account opening, cursor-paged)
- /api/v1/candles 1d closes (KR from 2022-11-23, US from 2021-11-30; delisted symbols return 404 stock-not-found)
- /api/v1/exchange-rate?dateTime=

Deposits, withdrawals and dividends must still come from outside the API.

Accounts: only BROKERAGE (종합매매) accounts in normal status are returned. Pension savings (연금저축), RIA, overseas derivatives, child accounts and 해지/휴면 accounts are not accessible. Holdings cover only KR/US stocks; overseas options and bonds are excluded.

Token handling: only one valid token per client, and a new token immediately revokes the old one. Share one cached token across processes and cron jobs (file plus lock), and re-issue only on expiry, 401 expired-token or 401 token-revoked. Otherwise processes keep revoking each other.

The IP allowlist is mandatory. A changing public IP (home DHCP, a cloud VM without a static IP, serverless, mobile data) gets 403: access_denied at /oauth2/token, and a 403 on other REST calls and the WebSocket handshake. The FAQ says cloud and datacenter ranges are not blocked as such; the IP just has to be registered.

Data-use policy (FAQ): API data may be used only for the investor's own trading purposes. Redistribution to third parties is prohibited even for non-commercial use. A personal, single-user tracker fits; don't publish or share dashboards containing API data.

Secondary tossctl docs (migration/open-api.md, confirmed 2026-07-01) quote an older rate-limit table: MARKET_DATA 10/s, MARKET_DATA_CHART 5/s, ORDER 6/s (3/s at peak). The current overview.md says MARKET_DATA 15/s, MARKET_DATA_CHART 20/s, ORDER 10/s. Trust the X-RateLimit-Limit header at runtime.

Spec version note: openapi.json declares 3.1.0 (nullable types written as ["string","null"]), while llms.txt calls it OpenAPI 3.0. OpenAPI 3.0-only codegen tools may mis-handle it; hand-written requests code is unaffected.
Candle pagination: before is inclusive, and the spec example's nextBefore equals the oldest candle already returned. De-duplicate by timestamp when paging.
unresolved: Whether cashBuyingPower (KRW or USD) includes unsettled sale proceeds, excludes amounts reserved for pending orders, or folds in the other currency via 통합증거금/auto-FX. The spec says only '현금 기반 매수 가능 금액 (미수 미발생 기준)'. No documented way to get exact 예수금 or total cash.
Whether expires_in is always 86400. The spec gives it only as an example ('토큰 만료까지 남은 초'). Secondary tossctl docs say 24h; no primary source guarantees it.

Whether issuing client_id/secret in WTS 설정 > Open API requires a prior application/approval or in-app identity verification. Secondary tossctl docs mention '사전신청→승인' and were waiting for 토큰 승인. The official overview lists only issuing credentials and registering IPs.

Whether /oauth2/token also accepts HTTP Basic client authentication (client_secret_basic). Its 401 sends 'WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="openapi"', but only form-body client_id/client_secret are documented. Use the form body.

The exact error code on a REST (non-token) 403 from a non-allowlisted IP. The overview says only '403 으로 차단'. Its error table lists 403 edge-blocked ('허용되지 않은 요청입니다') and 403 forbidden but does not tie either explicitly to the IP allowlist.

Whether holdings with a wrong or foreign accountSeq returns 404 account-not-found (overview table) or something else. The holdings operation's 404 refs the generic NotFound response, whose example is stock-not-found.
How far back /api/v1/exchange-rate?dateTime= history goes. Only the 404 exchange-rate-not-found case is documented.
The UTC offset of US 1d candle timestamps (US local midnight vs KST). The spec says '현지 자정 고정'; only KR examples are given.
